prompt: A singer can shatter a wine glass with a sustained note, but only if the note is exactly right. The note works when it matches the glass's:

options.text: Loudness limit, beyond which any glass breaks
Natural resonant frequency, so each vibration adds to the last and the oscillation builds until the glass fails
Colour frequency, which the glass absorbs as heat
Echo delay, so reflections inside the glass add up

explanation: At resonance, a driving vibration at an object's natural frequency transfers energy efficiently cycle after cycle, so the amplitude grows large. A glass vibrated strongly enough at its resonant frequency can flex beyond its limit and shatter.
